questions.questionText: GDP of a country measured at current market prices was $1000bn in year 1. This had risen to $1100bn in year 2. Over the same period the general price level had risen by 5%. What has happened to real GDP?

options.A: Real GDP fell by approximately 5%.
options.B: Real GDP fell by approximately 10%.
options.C: Real GDP rose by approximately 5%.
options.D: Real GDP rose by approximately 10%.

questions.questionText: A country’s currency depreciates in terms of other currencies. What would be a consequence of this depreciation?

options.B: There would be a decrease in the volume of exports.
options.C: There would be an increase in cost-push inflationary pressure.
options.D: There would be an increase in the budget deficit.

options.C: increased by 10
